android.desc: Chessify is an all-in-one chess platform built for players who want to improve with professional-level chess tools. Analyze with powerful cloud engines running on servers up to 1024 threads and 1 Billion NPS (1,000,000 kN/s) speed, explore databases of 12 million+ professional games (OTB and correspondence chess games), scan real chessboards and books, prepare openings, and review games from anywhere. Features that once required heavy desktop software are now available in a single mobile app designed for players of all levels. Whether you’re solving puzzles, training openings, or analyzing tournament games, Chessify combines advanced chess tools into one fast and easy-to-use experience. Main features: Powerful Cloud Engine Analysis Analyze with Stockfish 18, Lc0, Berserk, Caissa, Crystal, Patricia, Viridithas, AsmFish, ShashChess, Koivisto, RubiChess, and Sugar AI chess engines on cloud servers with up to 1024 threads, reaching up to 1BN/s speed. Chessify has been recognized by FIDE as the No.1 cloud service provider for chess analysis. Mega OTB-game Database Search through 10 million+ professional FIDE-rated games with move statistics, player ratings, and opening trends. Correspondence Chess Database Study the 2 Million+ official ICCF database games played with deep engine-assisted preparation. Scan 2D & 3D Chessboards Scan real boards and diagrams from books or screens with high accuracy and instantly analyze the position with Stockfish 18. Chess PDF Scanner Import chess PDF books and scan positions directly from pages for quick analysis and study. Play Against Stockfish Challenge one of the world’s strongest chess engines with adjustable strength settings. Play from initial or any given position. PGN & Move Notation Create analysis files with multiple variations and comments or import your existing files and review them with your phone at any time. Save Games & Analysis Store your games, analysis, and studies locally or in the cloud and access them anytime. Import, Export, and Share PGN/FEN Easily import your games or export positions and analysis to share with chess friends or students. Whether you’re a beginner, club player, coach, or grandmaster, Chessify provides powerful analysis and training tools for every stage of your chess journey.
